notes.title: Update! 26th May,2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/cdc3f48b0476cde55ee1fbf4e12ad8a8e62918e3.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone!
How are you?
We are pleased to inform you that we have made a major update.


[h3] New "Area 4" added [/h3]

Finally, new area has been added!
The new area has a variety of stages that are different from the previous areas!


[h3] Added "Bonus stage" to Area 4 [/h3]

Like the previous bonus stages,
Bonus stages will appear as you build MAP structures.


[h3] Add ITEM to drugstore [/h3]

Added new items to Area 3 and Area 4 drugstores.
It will appear when you purchase all the items in the drug store.


[h3] Add treasure chests to various places [/h3]

Treasure chests have been newly installed in various places.
Please look for it!


[h3] Add Story-Ending [/h3]

The ending has also been added.
This is when you clear all area 4 and clear the bonus stage in area 4,
You can see.
Please try to reach the end of the story! !


Other small bugs are fixed.

Now, the period of early access is only one week left.
In the time left, I want to add as many elements as I can.



If you like it, please write a review on STEAM!
It is my great encouragement!

Thank you for playing this game!
See you soon!

notes.title: Update! 10th May,2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/02f615146d6b1d6d2a55f50745f2695d266da57b.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Summer is approaching!


[h3]Third area added[/h3]

In this update,
A third area has been added! ! Yay!

The third character appeared.
and a new story begins.

Please enjoy it!



Updates will continue to be made in the future.
In the next update,
We plan to implement STEAM achievements.

At the same time, we plan to proceed with the production of Area 4.

looking forward to! !
Thank you for your playing the game.
